test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Walter said to David, “ I am looking forward to tomorrow’s auction.”

options.text: Walter told David that I am looking forward to tomorrow’s auction.
Walter told David that he is looking forward to the next day’s auction.
Walter told David that he was looking forward to tomorrow’s auction.
Walter told David that he was looking forward to the next day’s auction.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Walter told David that he was looking forward to the next day’s auction.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Present Continuous Tense.
 
• Present Continuous Tense changes to Past Continuous Tense.
 
• **Said to** changed to **told**.
 
• Remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• The first person in reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• Use that in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• Tomorrow changed to 'The next day.'
 
 
• Example: *Isha says, “I am going tomorrow.”** *(Direct speech)

 * Isha says that she is going the next day.* (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Walter told David that he was looking forward to the next day’s auction.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• If the sentence of Direct speech has a question that cannot be answered by saying yes or no then it does not use “if” or “whether” in its Indirect speech.

 
 
• Example: * **She said to me, “Where did you buy this dress from?” *(Direct speech)

 * **She asked me where I had bought that dress from. *(Indirect speech)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• Direct Speech को Indirect Speech में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Present Continuous Tense में है।
 
• Present Continuous Tense, Past Continuous Tense में बदल गया।
 
• Said to, told में बदल गया।
 
• Commas और inverted commas हटा दे।
 
• Reported speech में first person, reporting speech के subject के अनुसार बदलता है।
 
• Indirect speech के वाक्य में that का प्रयोग करें।
 
• Tomorrow, The next day में बदल गया।
 
 
• Example: *Isha says, “I am going tomorrow.”** *(Direct speech)

 * Isha says that she was going the next day.* (Indirect speech)
